{{Quote|I came from a pacifist colony, Master Jedi. We were bullied remorselessly: by pirates, corporations, Hutts, even governments. I joined the military as soon as I could. Peace only comes to those willing to fight for it.|Fideltin Rusk|audio=Rusk1.flac|<ref name="Passive Resistance">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Passive Resistance}}</ref>}}
A '''colony''' of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Founded sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3680 BBY]], the [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|birthplace]] of [[Fideltin Rusk]], a Chagrian who rebelled against the colony's extreme pacifism and enlisted in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. However, the colonists' refusal to take action against those who oppressed them led to the colony's [[Attack on Mindor|destruction]] at the hands of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire in [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]].

==Description==
A small [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Holonet" /> the settlement on<ref name="Mindor note" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]<ref name="Mindor note" /> was inhabited by colonists who were extremely devoted to the pacifist ideals<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> that were common in Chagrian culture,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> to the point that they refused to fight back against those who took advantage of them. The colony was harassed, terrorized, and manipulated by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], companies, and even various governments throughout its existence, but the Chagrians stayed true to their values and refused to fight even when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Attack on Mindor|attacked]] the colony.<ref name="Passive Resistance" />

==History==
{{Quote|Ten years ago, the colony was attacked by the Sith. My family was killed. They never fought back. The Sith crushed them, the way you might step on a bug.|Fideltin Rusk|audio=Rusk2.flac|<ref name="Passive Resistance" />}}
[[File:Rusk_on_ship.png|thumb|right|190px|Fideltin Rusk was raised in the Chagrian colony on Mindor.]]
Founded by [[3680 BBY]],<ref name="Date 1" /> the Mindor colony was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Fideltin Rusk's mother|mother]] and [[Fideltin Rusk's father|father]] of [[Fideltin Rusk]],<ref name="Holonet" /> who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the colony that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="Date 1" /> As he was raised in the colony, it endured the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, though Rusk grew disillusioned with his family's pacifist values<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sergeant Fideltin Rusk}}</ref> and enlisted with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as soon as he was able.<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> In the year [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]],<ref name="Date 2" /> early during the tense [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the Empire,<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> the colony suffered an Imperial attack during an illegal incursion into Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The colony was wiped out, and the news of his family's [[Death/Legends|deaths]] drove Rusk to become increasingly reckless with the lives of his [[Republic soldier|soldiers]] and even more devoted to the Republic Military.<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chagrian colony was first mentioned on the official site for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], in [[the Holonet]] entry for Fideltin Rusk.<ref name="Holonet" /> A companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class, Rusk also mentions the colony and its fate in the conversation "Passive Resistance,"<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> and the colony is mentioned in the in-game Codex under Rusk's entry.<ref name="Codex" />
